content: A plane P is parallel to two lines whose direction ratios are $$-2,1,-3$$ and $$-1,2,-2$$ and it contains the point $$(2,2,-2)$$. Let P intersect the co-ordinate axes at the points $$\mathrm{A}, \mathrm{B}, \mathrm{C}$$ making the intercepts $$\alpha, \beta, \gamma$$. If $$\mathrm{V}$$ is the volume of the tetrahedron $$\mathrm{OABC}$$, where $$\mathrm{O}$$ is the origin, and $$\mathrm{p}=\alpha+\beta+\gamma$$, then the ordered pair $$(\mathrm{V}, \mathrm{p})$$ is equal to :
